name: jaigent
description: Connect ChatGPT to a user-hosted jAIgent service through authenticated remote MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use your self-hosted jAIgent agent from ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Use jAIgent's existing remote MCP tools, gateway and persistent sessions. Provider credentials and workspace storage stay on your host; tool results are returned to ChatGPT. ChatGPT Web requires a remote HTTPS app and plan support.
defaultPrompt: Use jAIgent's workspace tools to inspect this project.
